title: Thoughtful words help conversation grow
meaning: Your considered words can begin a warm, detailed conversation when understanding leaves room for each other’s living account of an experience.
text: The Hermit in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in words that follow reflection: you do more than respond, sharing something you have come to understand for yourselves. The Empress in energy encourages you to develop the conversation, allowing details and new connections to emerge. The same Empress in emotions has a different role: experiencing warmth and richness through talking. The intention to nurture a conversation and the pleasure of having it can support each other while remaining distinct.

For example, over tea you explain why a brief meeting with an old acquaintance mattered. Instead of a quick “It went well”, details appear: one remark recalled a forgotten interest, while another offered a different view of a familiar disagreement. **A detail makes understanding available to each other**. You can ask about a moment that stood out and hear more of the story. The conversation feels warm because your considered experience has room in it, rather than because every detail is pleasant.

Difficulty appears if you bring such a finished explanation that there is no space for a different response. Warmth may then seem to depend on having your conclusion confirmed. The constructive wish to develop communication helps sustain interest in the answer: the story has been reflected on, but its meaning for you together can still grow through another perspective.
